decisions.decision: Revive-in-place for auto-resume — no new job created
decisions.rationale: Eliminates orphaned RUNNING jobs and superseded_by chains. Worker receives original job_id.
UX: user wants old failed job visible + new running job. Orphan cleanup added to except block.

decisions.decision: Wave 4b: cleanup pass removes dead superseded_by before main resume loop
decisions.rationale: If manual retry successor FAILed, original INTERRUPTED job must be resumable again.
FAILED is non-retryable. Belt-and-suspenders for when lifespan cleanup fails at cold start.
_process_asset always creates new BackgroundJob. Revive-in-place would produce two RUNNING jobs without this fix.

decisions.decision: Stale RUNNING watchdog: download+sync_daily only, 3h, marks INTERRUPTED
decisions.rationale: sync_full/historical can run hours. INTERRUPTED lets auto_resume retry; FAILED is terminal.
